Well not sure exactly what type of mmo you are looking to play but ive played a few months of the Albion Online beta and i quite enjoyed it. It's heavily guild focused but single player and small group play are still possible albeit more tedious. The grind isn't too bad if you change it up and grind different things when you get tired/bored of one thing. Like if you're sick of grinding mobs you can go tend your farms or gather resources instead. Lots to do. The pvp is good and is a nice change of pace from games like rust where who sees who first and who has a better gun generally determines the winner. In albion it takes a little longer to take out someones health bar so a lot of strategy and decision making come into play mid-fight and group weapon ability dynamics make things complicated and interesting. Even gear isnt the be all and end all as the gear improvement is a flat curve meanin if tier 1 is level 10 then tier 2 is 11 so in a head on fight, lower tiers still have a chance if the better geared player makes a mistake or isnt properly backed up. The economy is really well constructed with each city having its own AH that isnt connected to any other AH. Goods have a physical position and must be moved through the world by players such that they are vulnerable to attack and looting sorta like EVE. The graphics are super simple so the game runs really well even on old hardware but has a really pleasant aesthetic so its not painful to look at. The game world has atmosphere and is getting even better as the devs are still improving it. PVE is very basic atm, just straightforward 4-5 man or 10-12 man dungeons filled with copy-pasted trash mobs and some bosses with very simple mechanics, however its still pretty fun to do them with friends. There are plans to put more effort into the dungeons as it's something that is heavily requested by the community but not sure how long it will take. For now the game is heavily pvp focused as it's easier to make interesting gameplay with less effort for the devs. Anyway maybe i better stop typing before this gets too long. Its a fun game its worth checking out the website at least and maybe a lets play vid but its still in beta and will be wiped before launch so many including myself are waiting until launch to really get into it. Hope to see you on the battlefield at some point.
